bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to antipoverty grants; appropriating money for community action grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; COMMUNITY ACTION GRANTS ONGOING FUNDING.

$2,700,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,700,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for community action grants under Minnesota Statutes, sections 142F.30 to 142F.302.
additions: APPROPRIATION; COMMUNITY ACTION GRANTS ONGOING FUNDING.

$2,700,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,700,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for community action grants under Minnesota Statutes, sections 142F.30 to 142F.302.
